entries.title: A card's words keep one size on a wide iPhone or iPad screen
entries.body: On a wide screen, such as an iPhone Duo open on its side, a card's words were drawn larger than the same card's words on a narrower screen. They now keep the size your Text Size sets, whatever the card's width, and so do a panel's.
entries.noPicture: One picture of a card looks like any card; the fix is that its words keep the same size as the card gets wider.
